trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. It needs no multiplayer and no DLC; every trophy is single-player. Work through the three roadmap steps and this one follows on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, and the first one most players earn: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It cannot be missed — just play the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Chapter trophies tend to pop a mission or two into the next chapter rather than at the chapter card itself, so do not worry if it lands late. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — that one may not come back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Once both characters can roam together, the partner trophies open up: losing a 4-star wanted level with your partner along earns Hot Together, and robbing shops together earns Retail Therapy.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. This chapter opens a lot of the side systems: Andy's strand starts with a phone call, Randy's sports-car wish list opens, Tyrone's lab strand begins, and the Snap Gun from a main mission is what Sneakthief needs later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in this chapter, and they feed several trophies at once: the vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal, the armored truck for A Classic Blitz Play, and the 4-star wanted level that helps Hot Together.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: The gold story trophy for finishing the final mission in Chapter 5. After the ending you return to free roam, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, and everything left on it can still be done — nothing is locked off by finishing the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the main mission Breakfast Run. Like every story trophy it pops as you play the missions in order and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the main mission The Cartel Heist. Heist practice here pays off later — the bank jobs and vault robberies in free roam reuse the same ideas for Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the main mission Child's Play. Story trophies need no special approach — keep playing the missions and they land.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the main mission Headliners. It is one of three mission trophies in Chapter 4, alongside the VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory missions.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport comes back into play for Catch Me If You Can, where a passenger jet parked at a gate is the target instead of a mission objective.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the main mission Operation Savage Glory. With it, the Chapter 4 mission trophies are done and only the final mission's gold remains on the story side.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the whole of roadmap step 2. After the story, the checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: most rows need only part of a set, such as 15 of 18 card sets or 70 of 80 challenges. The rows that need everything are the robberies, the underwater discoveries, the shooting ranges, the drone races and Bret's hunting quests. Nothing on the checklist is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land any 250 stunts: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and there are 397 in the world. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past this trophy — the same runs feed both. Stunts also count toward the Master of None activity set.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. One try each is enough — no wins or medals are needed. Most of these pop naturally while sampling the map in step 1; check the list early and mop up whichever type you have not touched.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The 100% checklist needs all 42 as well, so this trophy and that checklist row are the same job. The gold medals here are reported as not too difficult, and there are no mission gold medals to worry about anywhere else in the game.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. The 100% checklist also wants all 42 drone time trials across those same 14 spots, so race and time-trial each location while you are there. Nothing here is missable — every location stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word — winning the same race again does not add to it. The 100% checklist raises the bar to 30 of 40 unique races won plus 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals, so racing toward this trophy is also racing toward A Long Road.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You meet Cal in Chapter 1 and he later texts you a fishing spot, which is where the challenge happens. Fishing is also one of the nine activity types for Master of None, so this is two trophies from one afternoon on the water.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any one in-game video game through to the end. Three of them run on the TV at home and a fourth runs on arcade machines out in the world. Finishing one also ticks off the video game type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand. It is a Lucia-only strand that starts with a phone call in Chapter 3. Stranger strands are not part of the 100% checklist, so this is step 3 cleanup — and Andy stays available in free roam after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand: seven shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later in the story, which looks like a miss but is not — he comes back and the strand can be finished in free roam. The diving also feeds the underwater discoveries the 100% checklist needs all of.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2. Like the other stranger strands it is not needed for 100% completion, so leave it for step 3 if it does not come up naturally during the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some side questlines count toward the eight, and the guides are still confirming exactly which ones qualify — so finish more than eight strands rather than stopping at the number. Every strand can be done after the story, and Strangers & Freaks is not part of the 100% checklist, so this is the main job of step 3.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand: a wish list of 16 sports cars to find and deliver. It opens in Chapter 3. Car spotting along the way also feeds Whip It Good and the 200 scanned vehicles the 100% checklist needs, so scan everything you find for Randy with the WAiNK app.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand by shutting down labs in Vice City. It is a Jason-only strand from Chapter 3. Tyrone is one of the quest givers tied to a trophy who stays around in free roam after the ending, so the strand can be finished in step 3.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one possibly missable trophy in the game, and the miss is in Chapter 1: one morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house and walks out to the balcony. Follow her, accept the prompt, and she shows you how it works. That balcony meditation raises the counter by one but is not marked as a meditation spot like the others, and it is gone after Chapter 1 — the guides have not confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so just do it when it comes up. The last spots need both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, so this trophy asks for three more than the checklist does.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. It is a Jason-only strand from Chapter 2. The guides have not confirmed which animal triggers it, so the safe route is the one that also serves the 100% checklist: clear all 15 of Bret's target decks, which the checklist needs in full, and the unique hunt should be covered along the way.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. The 100% checklist is stricter — it needs 15 of 18 sets found — so card hunting for this trophy is also card hunting for A Long Road. Pick up cards as you pass them rather than leaving the whole set for the end.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count. Make it a habit from the start of the story: scan every new place and every new vehicle as you pass it, and the 100 comes on its own. The 100% checklist needs the same 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and that row are one job.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so keep going past this trophy — and because only 70 are needed, the hardest ten challenges can be skipped entirely. Challenges overlap with nearly everything else on this list, so most of the 50 arrive while doing other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. It becomes possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2. The easy way is a bank job, which hands you a 4-star wanted level anyway — then break line of sight, stay out of the search area until the stars clear, and do not get spotted again on the way out.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner along, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them. Keep the heat the whole way: do not let the stars clear and do not get caught. The trophy pops about thirty seconds after the third shop, so do not panic if it does not land instantly.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with the WAiNK app is enough — you do not have to drive them. Scan every new model you pass from the start of the story and this lands early. The 100% checklist doubles it to 200 of 277 base models, so keep scanning after this pops.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, build your focus up with food, drinks or a shower at home, carry Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle. Gang members count toward the five; soldiers, police and civilians seem not to, so pick a fight with a gang.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly about a kilometre away from it. The jet is the hard part — get to a gate, get aboard, and get airborne before the airport response catches up. No mission is needed; it works in free roam.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino. The guides found tanks at Mile Zero Air Station in the south-west of the map. Expect a heavy response the moment you climb in; plan an escape route before you take it rather than after.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you — so this cannot be done before then. Plan the approach before going in: detection fails it, and the trophy is about staying unseen, not about speed.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape with the take. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are eight vaults in total and the 100% checklist needs all eight, so do all of them rather than stopping at five. A vault job hands you a 4-star wanted level, which is also the opening Hot Together needs.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts for this, or you can do it earlier on your own by blowing open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb. Either way the escape matters as much as the robbery — the trophy only pops once you are clear.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the far corners and the islands. The 100% checklist tracks the same ground through its discovery rows, so exploring early also feeds those.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39 gang operations cleared, so keep robbing past the one-per-gang mark — the same operations feed both the trophy and the checklist row.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. That is all the official description promises, and the exact method is not yet confirmed by any guide — the trophy writers list its condition as unknown. Try the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach in free roam, and check back: this entry will be updated when a guide confirms the spot.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style. The exact method is not yet confirmed by any guide — the trophy writers list its condition as unknown. It is not missable as far as anyone knows; the showrooms stay open in free roam, so this is a cleanup trophy to attempt once the method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all three key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn — that is the follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The robbery comes back later if you miss it the first time, so it is not missable. It also counts toward the 39 gang operations the 100% checklist needs.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out strength on both Jason and Lucia. Work out together and both of them make progress — that is the partnership the description hints at. Strength training is a slow grind, so start it early and keep it going between missions rather than leaving it for the end.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your criminal profile. There is nothing specific to hunt here — the count climbs as you play, from robberies and crimes to the choices you make along the way. It comes naturally over a full playthrough; if it is the last one standing, keep playing and it will land.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The method is not yet confirmed: the guides list this trophy's condition as unknown, though the description hints at succeeding on a second try. The trophy writers suspect a link to a Payday Loans store. Do not force it — try the payday loan jobs in step 2 and see if it pops; this entry will be updated when a guide confirms it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The method is not yet confirmed: the guides list this trophy's condition as unknown, and the description reads like witnessing something strange. The trophy writers suspect a UFO questline. Keep it in mind during free roam exploration, and check back once a guide confirms the trigger.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The in-game hint points to a melee drive-by, and the trophy writers suspect a kick from a motorcycle is the way to do it. The exact method is not yet confirmed, so treat this as unconfirmed and try the motorcycle kick in free roam.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. The total adds up across robberies, and the dye pack jammer you need unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission. The 100% checklist needs the same $250,000 fenced, so this trophy and that row are the same job — bank jobs and vaults are the big earners.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest. It counts spending anywhere, so the money you would spend anyway on weapons and vehicles for other trophies feeds this one — do not buy things just for the count until the end, then top it up.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages. The guides put the total at about $160,000, and the real estate app you buy them through arrives in Chapter 2. Bank vaults are the best late-game earner if you are short. Garage space is also what On the Spot needs, so buy the garages first and register vehicles second.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes: buy the garages, then register the vehicles you store in them. Vehicles you discover for Whip It Good are the natural candidates.
trophies.name: On the Spot
